issues.claim: Kent Beck, David Heinemeier Hansson and Martin Fowler, all experienced developers, agreed on the value of self-testing code but disagreed on how much test-first and isolation through mocks help
issues.problem: The excerpt shows only the disagreement: Hansson's test-induced design damage, and Beck's reply that the damage comes from design decisions rather than from TDD. It does not show that all three agreed on the value of self-testing code. The excerpt also does not show that the disagreement was specifically about test-first.
issues.suggestedFix: Reword to what the page supports, for example: 'In the "Is TDD Dead?" conversations Kent Beck, David Heinemeier Hansson and Martin Fowler disagreed about whether TDD, with its pressure toward isolated tests and heavy mocking, leads to damaging design (Hansson called this test-induced design damage), or whether the damage comes from design decisions. Fowler himself separates self-testing code from TDD.' Apply the same change to the RU text.
